text: Monica (People Ops): Quick heads-up: two People Ops pilots start May 1. 1) Parental leave top-up (6-month pilot) 12 weeks top-up varies by region; applies to birth, adoption, surrogacy; pro-rated for part-time. Apply via HR portal and check "Top-up pilot". 2) Comp-time accrual for qualifying off-cycle work (on-call, late launches). Cap 40h, use within 6 months, manager approval required. Full policy: https://redwood.internal/hr/policies/2026-05-pilot-ptop-comp Tracking: review Nov 1.
